positions.as_written: Address hip and trunk control, which set the position the knee lands in.
Read landing ligament loading as modelled rather than measured.
Treat landing mechanics as modifiable risk with modest predictive value for an individual, which is the honest position the prevention literature supports.
Expect landing asymmetry to persist after reconstruction with normal laxity.
Measure slope where loading risk seems disproportionate to the injury.
Keep population risk reduction and individual prediction apart when counselling.
